usedFor: ActivityInfo stores program data in forms; Calendly books the meetings. When a record is added or changed in an ActivityInfo form, “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly can produce a booking link for the follow-up call.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new record is the moment a follow-up is due, so each one gets a fresh booking link. “Updated Record” would mint a link on every edit.

watchOut: Both ActivityInfo triggers, “New Record” and “Updated Record”, are polling, so a new record can take a short while to show up. Pick one form to watch.
